description: Machine-readable KalCode Definition of Done (AGENTS.md). Paths map to lanes; lanes map to the ordered lifecycle a change must finish. Implemented by `node tooling/release/ship.mjs classify|lifecycle|gate`.

desktop.description: Signed desktop app (Tauri shell, Rust crates, desktop frontend).

docs.description: Published desktop notes: owner-declared milestones use docs/releases/<version>.md; continuous builds use docs/builds/<identity>.md.

internal.description: Tooling, CI, tests, agent and dev files. Merge only.

rules.why: test-only files are never part of a production artifact
publish.mjs embeds the exact milestone release notes or continuous-build evidence in the signed updater descriptor

tooling, CI, agent/dev files, unpublished docs and the marketing film (kalcode-film/, a standalone npm project outside the pnpm workspace); the website does not render docs/*.md, and assets/ only feeds the committed brand generators
the kalcode-website Worker and its static build
the kalcode-api Worker (api.kalcoded.com), deployed with wrangler like the website
every Cargo workspace member (crates/*, apps/desktop/src-tauri) and bundled third-party code ships in the desktop app
a shared package ships wherever the apps that depend on it ship
a lockfile change ships wherever the importers whose dependency graph changed ship
changes every JavaScript install or build

fallback.why: unknown path: treated conservatively as both production lanes, never internal

test.text: Run the local gate for the touched lanes: node tooling/release/ship.mjs gate --base origin/main (CI runs the same checks when GitHub Actions is available).

review.text: Independent review of the diff; address every finding.

commit.text: Commit on a branch, never on main.

merge.text: Push the branch, open a PR, required checks green, merge. Never push to main.

desktop.version.text: Keep the owner-declared public version unchanged and increment the numeric +N build revision (1..65535) across tauri.conf.json, apps/desktop/package.json and Cargo.toml; write docs/builds/<x.y.z+N>.md. Only an explicit owner milestone uses plain x.y.z and docs/releases/<x.y.z>.md.

desktop.release.text: Signed release build and automated release gates: node tooling/release/ship.mjs --version X.Y.Z+N --commit <sha40> for a continuous build, or plain X.Y.Z only for an owner-declared milestone (test, build, certify, qa, stage).

desktop.publish.text: Publish the update: ship.mjs --phase publish, then the feed phases (website-assemble, website-merge, deploy, confirm).

desktop.verify.text: Verify https://kalcoded.com/releases/updater/stable.json serves the exact X.Y.Z+N build identity with kalcode.commit = the release commit, then production install/update on Windows and macOS (ship.mjs --phase live-verify, live-human).

website.build.text: pnpm --filter @kalcode/website build (writes dist/.well-known/kalcode-build.json with the commit).

website.migrate.text: Apply the expand-only D1 migrations first: wrangler d1 migrations apply kalcode-web --remote (in apps/website).

website.deploy.text: Deploy the kalcode-website Worker from merged main: wrangler deploy (in apps/website).

website.verify.text: Verify https://kalcoded.com/.well-known/kalcode-build.json shows the merged main commit, then check the changed pages live.

api.migrate.text: Apply the D1 migrations first: wrangler d1 migrations apply kalcode-api --remote (in apps/api).

api.deploy.text: Deploy the kalcode-api Worker from merged main: wrangler deploy (in apps/api).

api.verify.text: Verify https://api.kalcoded.com/v1/entitlement/keys answers, then exercise the changed routes live.

docs.publish.text: publish.mjs embeds docs/builds/<identity>.md for +N continuous builds and docs/releases/<version>.md for owner-declared milestones. Published notes/evidence are immutable.

docs.verify.text: Verify the notes in https://kalcoded.com/releases/updater/stable.json for that version.

internal.none.text: No customer release: merging is the last step, because no production artifact changed.

report.text: Report what shipped, where it is live (version, URL, commit), what was verified and any known issues.

api.note: api.kalcoded.com exposes no build stamp yet

run: cargo deny check bans licenses sources

gates.unavailable: the native desktop E2E harness is Windows-only (WebView2); CI runs it on windows-latest
